caption: The drawing displays a 5 by 5 grid of squares, each containing a depiction of a decorative button or bead in the upper section of the square and a faint, unfinished outline of the button's side or back view below it. The objects are circular or slightly rounded, with intricate patterns and a variety of colors including green, brown, pink, blue, black, gold, red, purple, and silver. Some objects have solid colors, while others feature geometric or floral designs, stripes, or grouped dots. The outlines are delicately rendered in pencil, while the front views are colored in either watercolor or colored pencil, offering vivid contrasts and fine detail within a generally neutral beige or cream background. The grid is neatly aligned, and the overall arrangement emphasizes the ornamental qualities and diversity of the buttons or beads depicted.
title: Buttons
